description: This file contains functions and event handlers related to managing Feishu subagents, including conversation resolution, binding, and event registration.

classes.name: FeishuSubagentContext
classes.description: Context object containing optional requester session key.

classes.name: FeishuSubagentSpawningEvent
classes.description: Event data for spawning a Feishu subagent, including thread request and requester info.

classes.name: FeishuSubagentDeliveryTargetEvent
classes.description: Event data for delivering messages to a Feishu subagent, including expectations and requester origin.

classes.name: FeishuSubagentEndedEvent
classes.description: Event data indicating a Feishu subagent has ended, identified by session key.

methods.name: summarizeError
methods.description: Summarizes an unknown error into a string message.

methods.name: stripProviderPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'feishu:' or 'lark:' prefix from a string.

methods.name: resolveFeishuRequesterConversation
methods.description: Resolves a conversation based on request parameters, including session key and target info.

methods.name: resolveFeishuDeliveryOrigin
methods.description: Determines delivery origin details based on conversation ID and optional delivery target.

methods.name: resolveMatchingChildBinding
methods.description: Finds a matching child binding for a given session key and requester info.

methods.name: handleFeishuSubagentSpawning
methods.description: Handles spawning of a Feishu subagent, including binding conversation and error handling.

methods.name: handleFeishuSubagentDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Handles delivery target events for Feishu subagents, resolving bindings and origins.

methods.name: handleFeishuSubagentEnded
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a Feishu subagent ends by unbinding session.

methods.name: registerFeishuSubagentHooks
methods.description: Registers event handlers for subagent lifecycle events with the plugin API.
